anti_llmism.note: Removed generic synthesis, false balance, canned transitions, and ornamental abstraction.

factuality.note: All factual material is bounded to explicit fictional commissioning artifacts.

citation_support.note: The exchange makes no external factual claim requiring a citation.

source_interpretation_boundary.note: Characters distinguish the record from what they infer about it.

character_consistency.note: Voice is expressed through behavior and attention, not assigned debate labels.

expertise_boundary.note: Questions and claims remain inside plausible expertise or explicit uncertainty.

continuity.note: Every concrete detail comes from a canonical artifact, life event, or earlier message.

reply_timeline_integrity.note: Reply targets exist, precede their replies, and depths are consistent.

concrete_grounding.note: Every message has a why-now, speech act, and exact concrete anchor.

personal_history_integrity.note: Recalled experiences belong to the speaking founder and predate the exchange.

naturalness.note: Paragraph lengths and speech acts vary; no message opens as a free-floating thesis label.

duplication.note: Each reply adds a question, record, correction, joke, or unresolved human detail.

linguistic_distinctiveness.note: The founders remain attributable without each reciting a profile summary.

director_non_authorship.note: The object creates opportunity; it does not prescribe conclusions or participation.

editorial_quality.note: The record reads as one developing conversation rather than six miniature essays.

state_change_bounds.note: Only one cultural memory is created; no belief or relationship movement is manufactured.
